{{Vanilla|Terracotta}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Terracotta''' is fired [[clay]]. In [[Matcha Flavoured]] it is made in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] rather than a furnace, and it can be broken down into [[brick]]s.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
A clay block fired in a mud kiln becomes terracotta ({{Value|Terracotta|cook_time|station=Mud Kiln}}); the vanilla furnace recipe is removed. Glazed terracotta is also made in the kiln.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/kiln/terracotta.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
The [[Mason]] sells 1 bulk terracotta for 1 [[obol]] at the apprentice level; it unpacks into 64 terracotta. Its tooltip reads "x64 Terracotta".<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/mason/2/terracotta.json}}</ref> See [[Bulk blocks]].

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
Any terracotta, plain or dyed, crafts into 4 [[brick]]s.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/brick_from_terracottas.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History
|{{History line|1.03|Glazed terracotta is made in the mud kiln.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Terracotta can no longer be made in an oven; it is only kilned.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|The [[Mason]]'s terracotta trade gives 1 [[Bulk blocks|bulk terracotta]], which unpacks into 64 terracotta, instead of the 64 terracotta themselves.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/mason/2/terracotta.json}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.3|The bulk block has an English name, "Bulk Terracotta", and the tooltip "x64 Terracotta"; before, the game showed raw translation keys.}}
}}
